extracted.name: Sheet Pan Shrimp and Sausage Bake
extracted.description: This easy shrimp and sausage bake combines andouille, potatoes, corn, and colorful vegetables with bold Creole seasoning, all finished together on a sheet pan.
ingredient_lines: 1 pound baby Yukon Gold potatoes, quartered
1 pinch salt and ground black pepper
1 red bell pepper, cut into 2-inch pieces
1 yellow bell pepper, cut into 2-inch pieces
1 orange bell pepper, cut into 2-inch pieces
1 pound uncooked medium shrimp, peeled and deveined
2 tablespoons chopped fresh parsley, or to taste
finely chopped green onion, or to taste
instruction_lines: Gather ingredients. Preheat the oven to 425 degrees F (220 degrees C). Spray a large sheet pan with cooking spray.
Place potatoes into a large pot and cover with salted water; bring to a boil. Reduce heat to medium-low and simmer until tender, about 10 to 12 minutes.
Add corn and boil for an additional 5 minutes. Drain. Cut corn into thirds.

Meanwhile, whisk 3 tablespoons olive oil, 3 tablespoons Creole seasoning, lemon juice, garlic, Italian seasoning, 1/2 teaspoon paprika, red pepper flakes, salt, and ground black pepper together in a small bowl until combined.
Combine boiled potatoes and corn, all the bell peppers, cherry tomatoes, onion, and sausage slices in a large bowl. Add seasoning mixture and mix evenly.
Spread potato mixture onto a sheet pan in a single layer. Place lemon wedges evenly on all sides of the sheet pan.
Bake in the preheated oven for 8 minutes.
Meanwhile, combine shrimp, remaining 1 tablespoon olive oil, remaining 1/2 teaspoon paprika, and remaining 1/2 teaspoon Creole seasoning in a bowl. Marinate for a few minutes.
Add shrimp to the sheet pan with the potato mixture after 8 minutes of baking and mix to combine.
Return sheet pan to the oven and bake until shrimp are opaque and reach 145 degrees F (63 degrees C), 6 to 8 minutes. Remove lemon wedges. Garnish with parsley and green onion before serving.
